rule: Re-graded by hand after the run, under the standard the judge rubric sets: an answer is correct when its ANSWER line states every expected value and contradicts none. Labels, qualifiers and extra correct detail are allowed. A hedge, a missing value or a different value is not, so ci-04 ("6-20 service pages"), si-02 (plugin basenames for slugs), el-10 (no templates/ directory) and the lr-08 answers that never name the CTA banner stay wrong. The graders and questions are unchanged.
